title: ShortOPD: Recovering Pruned LLMs with Short-to-Long On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2607.13124v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Structured pruning is a hardware-friendly way to compress LLMs, but it is mostly validated on multiple-choice recognition tasks, while the same compressed checkpoints can collapse on the free-form generation that deployment actually requires. Two observations trace this gap. First, greedy \textsc{pass}@$1$ nearly vanishes after compression, yet \textsc{pass}@$k$ recovers substantially under repeated sampling: useful generations are demoted, not erased. Second, the recoverable regime fails mainly through suffix repetition. Recovery should therefore train on the compressed model's own on-policy states with dense token-level supervision, which On-Policy Distillation (OPD) provides by reusing the pre-compression model as a frozen teacher. However, long on-policy rollouts spend early recovery budget on low-information repetitive suffixes, delaying loss descent. To mitigate this waste, we propose \textbf{\shortopd}, a short-to-long O

translated_title: ShortOPD：通过短到长的在线策略蒸馏恢复剪枝后的大语言模型
translated_abstract: 结构化剪枝是一种硬件友好的大语言模型压缩方式，但其主要在多选识别任务上得到验证，而相同的压缩检查点在部署实际所需的自由生成任务上可能会崩溃。两个观察揭示了这一差距。首先，贪心pass@1在压缩后几乎消失，但在重复采样下pass@k显著恢复：有用的生成被降级，而非被抹除。其次，可恢复区域主要因后缀重复而失败。因此，恢复应针对压缩模型自身的在线策略状态进行训练，并带有密集的令牌级监督，这正是在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过将压缩前模型作为冻结教师来提供的。然而，长的在线策略滚动会在早期恢复预算上浪费于低信息量的重复后缀，延迟损失下降。为缓解这一浪费，我们提出ShortOPD，一种短到长的在线策略蒸馏方法。
tldr: 本文提出ShortOPD，通过短到长的在线策略蒸馏，有效恢复结构化剪枝后的大语言模型在自由生成任务上的性能，避免了长滚动中重复后缀导致的训练浪费。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ShortOPD, a short-to-long on-policy distillation method that effectively recovers the free-form generation performance of pruned LLMs while avoiding training waste from repetitive suffixes in long rollouts.
